data.title: A tied house that never closed
paragraphs: Walter Brewing built this building in 1881 as a tied house: it could sell only Walter's beer. Around 1910 the brewery sold it.

In 1920 Prohibition arrived and the sign changed to George Berg Soft Drinks. Root beer went out over the bar, sometimes with something from the bottle kept underneath it. The drinking moved to the basement. The bar never closed.
The Johnson family bought it in 1981 and ran it for forty-four years. Draft root beer is still on the taps.

password.question: In 1920 the sign changed and George Berg sold something over the counter. What?
password.hint: It is still on the taps, in a frosted mug.

riddles.question: Who put up this building in 1881 and poured the first beer in it?
riddles.right: The brewery that built the room. The lock turns.
